remarks: Welcome to easy living in the highly desirable Oakbrook community. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo located in the Williamsville Central School District is an end-unit that includes a Garage. Step inside to find gleaming hardwood floors and new carpeting throughout. The main level features a welcoming living area with an updated Kitchen that includes all appliances. The Living Room features a bay window and wood-burning fireplace. The spacious  Formal Dining Room provides access to a private, fully fenced Patio. Upstairs, you’ll find 3 comfortable Bedrooms,an updated main Bathroom and new wall-to-wall carpeting. The freshly painted primary Bedroom has an ensuite Bath. A full Basement provides plenty of room for storage. The Garage is conveniently located across from the unit. Close proximity to the community Pool, Clubhouse & Tennis courts.
